rv.q: Wyrd is a witch play for hard times.
Minnicino's play, at least to me, didn't always feel clear in terms of how the dual worlds the sisters occupy operate.
I think you will be surprised by what they bring to the stage at the Greenhouse...

cn.t: Critics find this witchy tale about three immortal sisters in Brooklyn an intriguing if uneven mix of Shakespearean and Chekhovian influences, praising its poetic and playful moments while noting its constraints.
